description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.

written.description: Checks an agent skill before you install it, following the files it pulls in and asking a model whether any of it is trying to misdirect the agent. Each verdict carries the provenance behind it.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(artifact-integrity): contain matcher-local timeouts (#949)

The multiline prompt matcher reported its per-pattern timeout as a terminal analyzer limit. One expensive artifact therefore caused every later artifact to be marked partial without inspection.

Classify resource limits by scope: contain the matcher's local timeout to the affected artifact, while keeping shared workflow deadlines and output limits scan-terminal. Add regressions proving later artifacts continue after a local timeout and remain blocked after a global deadline.

Full-suite comparison against the same origin/main revision:

Main: 15,533 passed, 583 failed, 20 skipped, 250 deselected, 4 xfailed.

Fix: 15,534 passed, 583 failed, 20 skipped, 250 deselected, 4 xfailed.

The failure set is unchanged; the branch adds one passing regression test.
